vocabulary.definition: a continuous area or expanse; a length or extent of something
vocabulary.example: She decided to take a break after a long stretch of studying.
The company's dominance in the market was undeniable.

vocabulary.definition: a violent collapse inward, often resulting from an explosion
vocabulary.example: The implosion of the building was carefully controlled to minimize damage.

vocabulary.definition: to develop gradually, especially from a simple to a more complex form
vocabulary.example: Over time, humans have evolved to adapt to their changing environment.

vocabulary.definition: to collapse or cause to collapse violently inwards
vocabulary.example: The building started to implode after the demolition charges were triggered.

vocabulary.definition: a continuous attack or barrage of something
vocabulary.example: The city endured a relentless bombardment during the war.
